items.title: CoStar Group (CSGP) Stock Still Looks Fully Priced After A 64% Fall
items.summary: CoStar Group has seen its share price fall hard over recent years, which raises a straightforward question for investors who follow the stock closely. Is the current valuation still in step with what the business is earning today and what those earnings might reasonably support over time? The stock has declined 63.5% over the past 3 years, which puts the focus squarely on whether that reset has brought the share price closer to what its earnings can justify. items.title: US Hotel Rates Forecast to Rise 1.6% in 2027, Below Inflation
items.summary: CoStar and Tourism Economics forecast U.S. hotel rates rising just 1.6% in 2027, below 2.4% inflation, after rate drove most 2026 growth.
